blocks.text: CARTAGENA, Colombia — Gunmen took 25 people hostage at a supermarket in the Colombian tourist city of Cartagena on Tuesday, prompting a major security operation that included the deployment of snipers and the closure of nearby streets. The attackers appeared to have tried to rob an armored vehicle before fleeing into the supermarket and taking about 30 people hostage, authorities said. Five hostages have since been released, all elderly women, according to Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella.
